bengal.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: one catalog/configurator pilot image of the ELIGIE funerary monument. Image 1 is the exact monument geometry reference; image 2 is the BENGAL granite texture reference. Reproduce the complete monument from image 1 as a clean isolated studio product render. Preserve its long rectangular base, inset front step, raised side rails with inclined front ends, large bevel below the rectangular top slab, rear headstone support, and both overlapping curved headstone panels with their exact wavy top profiles and curved sides. IMPORTANT BICOLOUR STRUCTURE: retain the narrower LEFT sculpted wing as plain polished near-solid black stone with its exact shape; it is a permanent structural component. Change every other stone component, including the broad RIGHT headstone panel, slab, rails, steps and base, to BENGAL granite from image 2, dark charcoal with fine grey and white mineral grains at realistic stone scale. Remove the engraved white rose and all traces/reflections of that decoration, leaving a clean blank black wing. No text, decoration, accessories, flowers or vase. Reorient camera to be exactly centered on the monument longitudinal axis with no left/right yaw, front headstone faces parallel to image plane; use parallel orthographic projection with modest elevation sufficient to show slab and steps, not a three-quarter view. Keep the complete object visible with balanced margins in a square image. Uniform pale grey background and floor, soft contact shadow, gentle studio lighting, polished stone with restrained reflections. Preserve all structural parts and clear junctions, no invented extra parts. Requested 2048x2048. This Bengal image will be the unchanged geometry and framing master for nine material-only edits.
bengal.controleVisuel: Reference ELIGIE inspectee. Deux panneaux galbes conserves; aile noire gauche structurelle et rose retiree. Base, rails a bouts inclines, dalle et marche frontale presents. Vue axiale et cadrage entier; perspective residuelle et calibration non validee.
